derivedFrom.title: Race Steering wheel - Lamborghini Essenza SCV12

wheels.notes: Converted from the .blend source to glTF (Blender), modifiers applied and parts joined, scaled to 0.32 m wide, centred and turned to face +Z, textures reduced to 2048 px. The gauge graphic is painted black so the app's dashboard draws on a dark screen; the screen fit ships in the file.
